name: Archie factory manager (one playbook per stuck PR: stacked on a merged parent, or a conductor park a merge of main could not get past)

knobs.note: BH-4583: 0 stops the tick before any read. Read by bin/archie-fm.sh as ${ARCHIE_FM_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-fm.log and the default. The per-project switch is the settings row archie.manage[.<project>] = on|observe|off.

BH-4583: seconds the selected suites may run on a replayed child before the action is deferred (could not run, no push). The tick's deadline is derived from it (start + this + 600 s), so the bound is always reachable; a suite started late in a tick gets the time left if that is less. Suites run as nobody under env -i in a snapshot (afm_isolated). Read by bin/archie-fm.sh as ${ARCHIE_FM_SUITE_TIMEOUT_S:-900}; outside 60..3600 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4583: seconds a deferred archie_actions row waits before a later tick reclaims it (attempts+1). Read by bin/archie-fm.sh as ${ARCHIE_FM_RETRY_S:-1800}; outside 60..86400 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4583: attempts on one action before its row closes failed with ONE ALERTS line naming the git rebase --onto to run by hand. Read by bin/archie-fm.sh as ${ARCHIE_FM_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}; outside 1..10 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4583: projects read per tick; each tick starts one slot further round fleet.conf, so the rest are reached on later ticks (logged). Read by bin/archie-fm.sh as ${ARCHIE_FM_PROJECTS_PER_TICK:-0}; outside 0..100 is one warn line and the default.

Not a knob: bin/archie-fm.sh sets it to 1 when it re-execs itself under its backstop timeout (4320 s, above the deadline at the suite knob's maximum), so the child does not wrap itself again. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-fm.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-fm.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: the real epoch second bin/archie-fm.sh uses as the tick's deadline, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: seconds of the outer backstop timeout instead of 4320, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1, so a suite can drive a tick that outlives it. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam: `self` keeps the suite snapshot and env -i but skips the switch to nobody, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (a test runner that cannot setpriv). NOT settable from the control plane: on a box PR code always runs as nobody.

Test seam gate: bin/archie-fm.sh honours ARCHIE_FM_NOW, ARCHIE_FM_DEADLINE, ARCHIE_FM_TICK_CEILING_S and ARCHIE_FM_SUITE_AS and sources ARCHIE_FM_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it), and the suites it runs on a replayed child run with it set. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
